title: Quality Engineer II

Level of Problem Solving Solves moderately complex problems by analyzing data and applying pre-defined processes or past learnings. Key Job Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and backend systems. Derive and execute comprehensive test plans and cases based on system requirements. Integrate automated testing within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery. Perform functional, regression, and API testing, ensuring full test coverage. Familiarity with version control (Git/Git Hub). Good understanding of Java. Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and test management tools (JIRA, XRAY). Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Exposure to performance testing (JMeter, Gatling). Experience with CI/CD tools (Git Hub Actions). ISTQB or similar testing certification. Competencies Required Analytical Thinking: Breaks down complex requirements and identifies effective testing approaches. Collaboration: Works closely with developers and product teams to ensure shared quality ownership. Accountability: Owns testing deliverables from planning to closure. Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-moving Agile environment with shifting priorities. Continuous Improvement: Actively refines automation frameworks and testing processes. title: Product Analyst
jobDescription: Product Analyst Elemica, an award-winning digital supply chain company in the Saa S community, is seeking a driven and self-motivated Product Analyst for its Multi-Carrier Shipping Software. This is an opportunity to join a growing team of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our clients’ expectations. We’re looking for someone who stands out from the crowd — a proactive problem-solver who takes full ownership of their work, thrives with minimal direction, and is energized by tackling ambiguous challenges head-on. Our Values At Elemica, our success is founded on a shared set of core values that guide our decisions and actions: Curiosity — We delight in discovering new challenges and feel compelled to solve them Integrity — We are reliable and trustworthy, steadfast in our commitment to colleagues, customers, and partners Accountability — We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently. Passion — We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chains The Role As a Product Analyst at Elemica, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business users and technical teams, ensuring successful development and optimization of our product portfolio. You will balance business and product strategies while meeting client commitments — driving decisions independently and with confidence. You will work closely with the application development team on our world-class Multi-Carrier Shipping Solution, collaborating with product managers to define, develop, and release the highest value-generating capabilities. This role demands a self-starter mentality: someone who can pick up a challenge with little to no instruction and deliver results. What You’ll Do Own and drive the product backlog — refining epics into actionable stories with development teams Solicit, capture, and lead requirements for transportation and shipping applications Lead product sprint reviews, communicating value delivered and driving stakeholder alignment Document release plans and notes; conduct release demos and training for key stakeholders Serve as the subject matter expert on Elemica’s Multi-Carrier Shipping Solution Develop and maintain product documentation resources and knowledge bases Take ownership of team direction — lead and mentor team members as needed Manage small-to-medium development projects end-to-end, on time and on budget Troubleshoot and oversee complex integrations between Elemica and external source systems Leverage best practices in integrations and APIs to deliver and manage enterprise-level data flows Proactively identify and solve problems before they are escalated Requirements Shipping & Logistics Expertise Hands-on experience with Parcel, LTL (Less-than-Truckload), and FTL (Full Truckload) shipping Experience with both US Domestic and Global shipping operations Deep understanding of carrier requirements, compliance standards, and industry best practices Work Style True self-starter — able to take on new challenges and projects with little to no instruction Comfortable leading a team and guiding others toward shared goals Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on in approach Thrives in a high-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities Strong intellectual curiosity and a drive to find creative solutions to difficult problems Tools & Technology Proficiency with JIRA for backlog management and sprint tracking Experience with AHA! for product roadmap and strategy management Experience with MIRO for collaborative diagramming and workshops Demonstrated use of AI tools to enhance productivity and product thinking Familiarity with MS Office, Confluence, and Software Experience Management tools (e.g., Pendo) Collaboration & Communication 2+ years of experience as a Saa S software product analyst Agile/Scrum team experience — sprint ceremonies, retrospectives, story creation Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to audiences of all levels, including customers Experience with business needs assessment, requirement negotiation, and user story creation Experience with full SDLC and agile development in an enterprise software environment Nice to Haves SAP experience, particularly in modules such as SD (Sales & Distribution), MM (Materials Management), EWM (Extended Warehouse Management), TM (Transportation Management), and/or FI (Financial Accounting) Experience integrating with ERP, Transportation Management Systems (TMS), or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) MBA preferred Product Management Certification (e.g., CSPO, PMC) Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field 1–3 years of hands-on product analyst experience in a Saa S environment Our Values At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. title: Project Manager, SAP
jobDescription: Project Manager, SAP Our Values At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community: Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently. Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain Responsibilities & Objectives Elemica’s Project Managers are integral to our success and serve as trusted, dedicated advisors. Key to this role is experience in product-led implementation. We are looking for people who are self-motivated and driven to accomplish goals. Elemica values individual accountability as well as a global team approach to problem solving and knowledge sharing. What You’ll Do Project Managers at Elemica are responsible for the hands-on project management of client onboarding projects and change requests using a combination of Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Lead the requirements gathering process for the implementation of the appropriate solutions Manage coordination of the clients, partners, and working groups engaged in project work: Detailed project planning and control including: Use of Elemica Standardized PMO Toolkit (training provided) Developing and maintaining a detailed project plan Manage project deliverables in line with the project plan Record and manage project issues and risks; escalate where necessary Manage project scope and change control Monitor project progress and performance against project budgets Ongoing project management of open projects to ensure that the implementation of the Elemica solution remains current and relevant to the customers, and that opportunities for expansion of the business are identified Proactively build successful internal and external working relationships Coordinate the execution of client testing activities: Facilitate end-to-end partner testing Ensure the client and trading partners can transact on the Elemica network Take an active role in troubleshooting problems discovered during the testing process and work with internal and client resources through the resolution Understand and manage project risks, escalate where necessary and design mitigation strategies to avoid delays while meeting deadlines and staying in budget Suggest improvement efforts surrounding the processes and tools utilized in Elemica’s client onboarding process What You’ll Need 5+ years Project Management onboarding new clients in a Saa S environment and trading partner rollouts for existing clients Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related field of study (MBA preferred) SAP ECC and/or SAP S4/HANA experience. SAP EWM experience is a plus but not required Functional knowledge of SD/WM/LE/TM modules (or some combination thereof) Experience with and functional understanding of logistics or supply chain processes Exposure to cybersecurity and networking issues and technologies Excellent organizational skills including attention-to-detail and multi-tasking skills Fluency in English (written and verbal) Use of standard PC office packages (Teams, MS Office, Excel, Word) Ability to work independently Open-minded in receiving feedback and always striving for improvement Goal-oriented, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and deliver results Your Success. Your Well-being. Our Commitment: Elemica Benefits. We're passionate about empowering our team. Our comprehensive benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support every facet of your life and career journey: Market-Leading Pay: We ensure your talent is rewarded with competitive compensation. Complete Family Health: Comprehensive health insurance to protect you and your entire family. Secure Tomorrow: Build a strong financial future with robust retirement plans including EPF, Corporate NPS, and Gratuity. Flexible Work-Life: Embrace work-life balance through our hybrid model and flexible hours. Celebrate Achievement: Our annual and quarterly recognition programs foster a high-performance culture by consistently rewarding your excellence and driving success. Support for Life's Milestones: Beyond standard annual, sick, and casual leave, we offer dedicated time off for significant life events like marriage and paternity. Who We Are Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of Saa S-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually. It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties. title: Principle Software engineer , PS
jobDescription:
Principle Software engineer , PS Our Business Elemica offers a state-of-the-art supply chain operating network in the areas of customer & supplier management and logistics— promoting new levels of efficiency and profitability for a leaner and more fully optimized supply chain. Elemica’ s clients achieve significant value from reduced cost of operations, faster process execution with fewer resources through the automation of key business processes, removal of transactional barriers, and seamless information flow between business partners. Our Values All members of the Elemica team from our CEO to our newest entry-level employees are expected to adhere to a set of core values that we think are critically important to our success. Trust and Respect Growth and Development Communication and Collaboration Accountability and Ownership Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Principle Integration Consultant: Create and enforce best practices. Poses the knowledge of industry-standard implementations. Communicate/Work with the Client to generate a blueprint. Breaking down the blueprint provided to convert to Project action items. Mentor the team on best practices and Industry knowledge. Some level of SAP functionality. Accountability: Lead maintenance of customer solutions in partnership with the Global Customer Support and On Site teams Responsibility: Drive quality across enhancements and fixes delivered. Analytical: Lead impact analysis, change control, pull request, code review, and change management. Quality: Maintain version control for the solution. Visionary: Drive automation mindset across the SET organization. Self-Driven: Hire, motivate, and retain a team of analysts and engineers. Create and drive a high-performing team. Develop team members and yourself. EDI Knowledge: The developer should have a strong understanding of EDI standards such as ANSI X12, EDIFACT, or other relevant formats. They should be familiar with EDI transaction sets, segments, and elements. Mapping Tools Proficiency: Proficiency in EDI mapping tools like IBM Sterling B2B Integrator, Gentran Integration Suite, Cleo Clarify, or other similar software is essential. Programming Languages: Knowledge of programming languages like Java, Python, or Java Script is often required to develop custom mapping logic and integration with other systems. Data Transformation: The ability to perform data transformation between EDI formats and various internal data formats (e.g., XML, JSON, flat files) is crucial. Industry Experience: Familiarity with the specific industries where EDI is commonly used (e.g., retail, healthcare, logistics) is a plus as different industries may have specific EDI requirements. EDI Communication Protocols: Understanding of communication protocols used in EDI, such as AS2, SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, VAN, etc. Error Handling and Validation: Experience in handling errors and implementing validation rules to ensure data integrity and compliance with EDI standards. Testing and Troubleshooting: Ability to conduct thorough testing of EDI maps and troubleshoot issues that arise during testing or production. Documentation Skills: Clear and detailed documentation of EDI maps, mapping rules, and procedures is essential for knowledge sharing and future maintenance. Compliance and Security: Awareness of EDI compliance requirements and data security best practices to protect sensitive information during transmission and processing. Collaboration: Effective communication and collaboration skills are essential as EDI map developers often work closely with business analysts, trading partners, and IT teams. Adaptability: Willingness to adapt to changing EDI standards, technologies, and business requirements. Project Management: For more senior roles, experience in managing EDI mapping projects and ensuring timely delivery of solutions. Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in EDI standards, technologies, and best practices. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills to understand complex data structures and efficiently design EDI maps. Coach: Management experience with leading a team, should be able to learn new concepts and teach the rest of the team. Skills: Java Script and XSLT ANSI X12 and EDIFACT, IDOCS.
